title: Expose fail-closed tenant capability eligibility and typed remediation

phases.objective: Project the canonical Platform Plugin resolver decision into a tenant-safe eligibility state with typed blockers and non-mutating remediation guidance, without claiming readiness when binding, credential, certification, approval, or security gates fail.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated tenant user resolving a Platform Plugin capability
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: POST /tenant/platform/plugins/resolve after canonical User-JWT and active-membership authorization
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The response exposes ready, blocked, approval_required, unavailable, or deprecated eligibility plus typed blocker repair classes derived only from the canonical resolver result; no repair is executed by discovery.
steps: Resolve the requested capability through the existing canonical Platform Plugin resolver and its fail-closed security gates.
Strip the admin-only decision trace projection from the tenant response as before.
Project required denied or unevaluated gates into tenant-safe blocker codes and repair classes without reading new secrets or performing new database queries.
Return ready only when the canonical resolver reports execution.will_execute=true.

Classify missing runtime binding or smoke certification as platform_admin_required, credential intake as user_action_required, and connection ambiguity as tenant_admin_action_available without choosing a candidate.
Return the projection alongside the existing resolver response with secrets_included=false.
assertions: A dispatch-ready canonical resolver decision projects to status=ready with zero blockers.
Missing action binding projects to blocked + platform_admin_required and cannot be reported ready.
Missing smoke certification projects to blocked + platform_admin_required and cannot be reported ready.
Missing credential projects to blocked + user_action_required with credential/OAuth intake guidance only.
Multiple eligible connection ambiguity projects to blocked + tenant_admin_action_available and never selects a first candidate.
A pending governed approval projects to approval_required rather than ready.
Disabled and deprecated plugin states project to unavailable and deprecated respectively.
Discovery projection performs no repair mutation, provider call, migration, secret access, or Production action.
